note: Validation stream for every NLL this repository reports. Scoring convention lives in bench/reference_eval.py.
rationale: Pristine endpoint: no model in the comparison trained on it or selected against it, which is what the reference-eval stream cannot promise. Primary endpoint for the confirmatory test (docs/06 item 5).
token_stream_sha256_scope: sha256 of the token array's raw bytes (ids.tobytes()), NOT of the .npy file: a .npy carries a header, so file and array hashes can never match. Verify with bench/verify_stream.py or the test suite.
